# Appointory (https://appointory.in) - AI Search & LLM Context File
Domain: https://appointory.in
Platform: Appointory Healthcare OS & Clinic Operating System

Appointory is India's premier AI-powered clinic management system, OPD queue intelligence, smart medical billing with GST invoicing, instant patient messaging alerts, independent diagnostic lab network, and AES-256 encrypted digital health locker.

## Dynamic Context Endpoints
- Full Medical Knowledge Base: https://appointory.in/llms-full.txt
- Machine-Readable AI Policy: https://appointory.in/ai.txt
- Dynamic XML Sitemap Index: https://appointory.in/sitemap.xml

## Core Platform Capabilities & Search Entity Mappings

1. **Appointment Booking & OPD Scheduling**:
   - Seamless online doctor appointments, walk-in token generation, and multi-slot calendar scheduling.
   - Dedicated public clinic and specialist doctor profile pages with real-time slot availability.

2. **Smart Medical Billing & GST Invoicing**:
   - Comprehensive clinic billing engine with automated GST calculation (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%).
   - Itemized invoicing for consultations, diagnostic lab tests, procedures, and consumables.
   - Instant printable & downloadable PDF receipts with clinic branding and QR payment codes.
   - Complete daily revenue analytics, UPI/Cash reconciliation, and accountant-friendly reports.

3. **Instant SMS & Digital Queue Alerts**:
   - Real-time patient messaging without physical waiting room crowding.
   - Instant SMS dispatch via high-priority gateways when tokens are called or queue shifts.
   - Live encrypted web token link allowing patients to monitor line position from anywhere.

4. **AES-256 Medical Report Store & Patient Health Locker**:
   - Lifetime encrypted digital health locker for patient prescriptions, diagnostic reports, and medical history.
   - ABDM / ABHA national health ID integration and secure OTP-based patient access.
   - Instant automatic synchronization of verified pathology test results into the patient's vault.

5. **OPD Queue Management & AI Wait-Time Prediction**:
   - Machine learning dynamic wait-time estimation analyzing doctor consultation velocity and lobby rush.
   - Live waiting room Clinic TV Display mode featuring real-time token boards and audio chime callouts.
   - Multi-counter receptionist token management panel.

6. **Independent Pathology & Diagnostic Lab Network**:
   - 6-digit secure pairing code handshake linking independent diagnostic centers with OPD clinics.
   - Electronic lab test order dispatch, specimen barcode tracking, automated abnormal value highlighting, and digital report release.
